package consumer

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/config"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/core/contract"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/framework"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/httpkit"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/httpkit/router"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/logging"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/moduleapi"
	"github.com/tjahjono/gostack/security"
)

type Entity struct{ ID string }
type ProductRepository interface {
	contract.Repository[string, Entity, Entity, Entity, string]
}
type ProductService interface {
	contract.Service[string, Entity, Entity, Entity, string]
}

type Repository interface {
	Message(context.Context) (string, error)
}
type MemoryRepository struct{ message string }

func NewRepository(message string) *MemoryRepository { return &MemoryRepository{message: message} }
func (r *MemoryRepository) Message(ctx context.Context) (string, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return r.message, nil
}

type ServiceContract interface {
	Message(context.Context) (string, error)
}
type Service struct{ repository Repository }

func NewService(repository Repository) *Service                { return &Service{repository: repository} }
func (s *Service) Message(ctx context.Context) (string, error) { return s.repository.Message(ctx) }

type Delivery struct{ service ServiceContract }

func NewDelivery(service ServiceContract) *Delivery { return &Delivery{service: service} }
func (d *Delivery) RegisterRoutes(registrar router.Registrar) error {
	return registrar.Register(router.Route{Method: "GET", Path: "/api/v1/status", Policy: router.Policy{Access: router.Public}, Handler: http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		message, err := d.service.Message(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			httpkit.WriteError(w, r, err)
			return
		}
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, message)
	})})
}

type Database struct{}

func NewDatabase() *Database                      { return &Database{} }
func (*Database) Ping(ctx context.Context) error  { return ctx.Err() }
func (*Database) Close(ctx context.Context) error { return ctx.Err() }

type Readiness struct{}

func NewReadiness() *Readiness                     { return &Readiness{} }
func (*Readiness) Check(ctx context.Context) error { return ctx.Err() }

func TestPublicContractsAndConstructorInjection(t *testing.T) {
	descriptor, err := moduleapi.NewDescriptor("status", nil, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	component, err := moduleapi.New(descriptor, NewDelivery(NewService(NewRepository("ready"))), moduleapi.NewPassiveLifecycle())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	registry, err := framework.NewRegistry(nil, []moduleapi.Module{component}, time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	guard, err := httpkit.NewPolicyGuard(security.Providers{}, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mux, err := router.NewMux(registry.Routes(), guard)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	logger, err := logging.NewJSONLogger(io.Discard, "info")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stack, err := httpkit.NewStack(httpkit.Options{}, logger, security.NewSecureRandom())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	stack.Wrap(mux).ServeHTTP(response, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "http://app.test/api/v1/status", nil))
	if response.Code != 200 || response.Body.String() != "ready" {
		t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	provider, _ := config.NewEnvProvider(func(key string) (string, bool) {
		switch key {
		case "GOSTACK_ENV":
			return "test", true
		case "GOSTACK_DATABASE_URL":
			return "postgres://runtime@localhost/test?sslmode=disable", true
		}
		return "", false
	})
	settings, err := provider.Load()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	app, err := framework.NewWithDependencies(settings.HTTP, logger, NewDatabase(), NewReadiness(), framework.Options{Modules: []moduleapi.Module{component}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err = app.Close(context.Background()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var repository ProductRepository
	var service ProductService
	_, _ = repository, service
}
